title: Ashes Pickleball Flame
style: deep house, 124 BPM, hypnotic club groove, breathy spoken lead, call and response chants, rubbery sub-bass, muted four-on-the-floor kick, syncopated clap snaps, rimshot percussion, stuttered piano stabs, filtered Rhodes chords, short delay throws, tiled bathroom reverb, sidechain pumping, sparse breakdowns, hands-up release, focused euphoria
lyrics:
[singer A]
game begins, right on cue.
diffrent mind set, different view.
pickleball flame,
running through my vein
become centered, focused and true.
your paddle becomes an extension of you

[melodic interlude]

[singer B]
look at it, way up there, high in the sky. it's talking to me. i can hear it.
wind is in your favour, timeless. feel the breeze brush past your face, no blinding rays in sight.

[singer A]
feel it, drop, feel it, pop, givin it everything you got! we are here, for success. always playing at your best.

[transition]

[singer B]
i think i might..... i think i may...... yes...... all signs are clear.
its saying ....... SMASH IT go for it, the time is right. finish it! the the time is right now.
soooooo.o.o.o.o SMASH IT!

[singer A]
make the most of your tools, they are all that you got.
hands... feel it on the paddle,
eyes....allow you to anticipate,
now im not late
im right on time
using my sences
make. this. game. mine.

[instrumental]

[singer B]
perfect timing perfect position, your responcible for the creation of tge perfect smash.
o.o.o.o.o.o. SMASH IT! point over, your in over drive

[singer A]
i won you over,
you know its true
lives within my heart
could never be blue.
trust in you!
only you can make "your" dreams come true.
you, me,
us, we,
pickleball forever,
can you feel its power.
